items.label: Portable size
items.value: The thin canvas bag measures 13.7 x 15.5 inches and it can hold your daily necessities such as umbrellas, books, lunch boxes, and water bottles easily. You can fold and roll the canvas bags and put them in your pocket so it doesn't take up space

items.label: Suitable for DIY
items.value: These blank tote bags are perfect for drawing and decorating projects at home, or in camp, add your idea with paint and other craft tools for personalized gift bags to your loved ones. You can use some heat-transfer vinyl paper and do an iron-on transfer on the small tote bag, as well as do embroidery

items.label: Canvas tote bag
items.value: These cute tote bags are made of 5oz natural canvas, which is lightweight and sturdy. The thin tote bag has tight stitching throughout and has a good load-bearing capacity. The length of the handles is 9.05 inches, making it easy to carry by hand or over the shoulder

items.label: Multifunctional bulk tote bags
items.value: This black canvas tote bag is great for use at grocery stores or malls. The sublimation tote bags are also suitable as gifts for birthdays, Christmas, Thanksgiving, etc. You can use it as a library bag, church bag, party bag, bride bag, welcome bag, and other various event bags

items.label: Washing tips
items.value: It is not recommended to wash the thin cloth tote bag. In case of dirty, it is recommended to wash by hand in cold water, and iron after drying. When doing a heat transfer project, keep the temperature below 160-170°C
